approval.approved_statement: Peter authorized deployment of the final qualified rc.5 candidate to both existing Pi instances; this exact binding records its protected source, actual publication and two immutable profile artifacts within that scope.

constraints: This source candidate is not dispatch authority until exact reviewed protected Core delivery, valid release evidence and separate Finalization are read back.
Consume only these immutable source/profile/artifact bindings through the qualified two-instance consumer and canonical readiness preflight.
Independently validate fresh fixed-configuration resolution, negotiated ed25519 fingerprint, hostname, complete model, architecture and device profile before mutation.
Serialize mutations per physical instance; no automatic retry, failover, rollback, credential/sudo change or inferred cancellation.
Preserve configuration, pairing, server Profile, previous release and recovery evidence; no pairing/reset/Profile selection or HA repair is authorized here.
Deployment and separate matching smoke remain per-instance operations; overall operational success requires both current successful deployment/smoke joins.
Actual installed captures follow bounded deployment/smoke; source/package success is not live Session, physical touch, audio, speech or complete Apple-parity acceptance.
